facts.fact: Q2FY27 results and presentation filed 3-Nov-2026; Screener's Sep-2026 quarter shows consolidated sales Rs 3,519 cr (+69% YoY), operating profit Rs 1,005 cr (OPM 29%), net profit Rs 650 cr, EPS Rs 68.19.
Q2FY27 earnings call audio (4-Nov-2026) and transcript (6-Nov-2026) filed; press summaries say management expects FY27 revenue and EBITDA to exceed the Rs 14,000 cr guidance.
Board (3-Nov-2026) appointed Price Waterhouse LLP and re-appointed Gandhi Rathi & Co as joint auditors for 2027-2032, subject to shareholder approval.
ICICI Direct published a post-Q2 note on 4-Nov-2026 (Buy, Rs 23,200).
Defence export order announcements reported in Oct/Nov-2026 (trade press, dates unreliable).
Sep-2026 shareholding (Screener): promoters 73.15%, FIIs 6.13%, DIIs 13.55%, shareholders 139,491.
Share price Rs 18,365 on 23-Oct-2026 and ~Rs 18,840-18,860 in mid-Nov-2026.
